Re COZY Time for tires! 4,6,8 ply $100 $300 Mike Satchell wrote To from this group and stop receiving emails from it, send an email to cozy builder... . . ! macl... My 3 sets of Cozy tires so far 1 old used set of Michelin Air Hawks, 6 ply, used for aircraft construction and some taxi testing2 a new set of Wilkerson retreads, 6 ply, used for taxi testing and flying3 a new set of Desser Monster retreads, 10 ply, used for flyingI use the same air pressure in all three sets. The biggest difference I notice is that the Dessers become annoyingly out of round after being parked several days. The Cozy wobbles down the taxiway and runway. It doesn't go away in cold weather although it does go away after a mile on the ground in warm weather. The Good Years and the Wilkersons always smoothed out after 10 to100 feet of ramp taxi.Nothing is free. Changing from a softer tire with less plies to a harder tire with more plies will give you more miles per tire, greater durability, and a worse ride quality. Softer tires typically provide better traction with that better ride quality, but that doesn't seem to be a noticeable factor with our airplanes. This is true in cars, trucks, atv's, and airplanes.Andrew AnunsonCozy MKIV 1273Pound, VA
